code='''def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    # Colors repeat by diagonal offset; retain the observed sequence indexed by c-r.
    vals={}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):

    seq=[0]*18
    for k,v in vals.items(): seq[k]=v

    for k in range(18):
